reply_text:
The nine commits are ready to push as a fast-forward, with no host paths in the diff. Before pushing, I'm running the full test suite on both this branch and Rob's `main` to compare failure counts.The suite runs themselves are under bg.py and will survive, but the waiter I just started won't if this turn ends. So I'll add a bg.py waiter that bells me in work mode when both runs finish.Both runs failed straight away because the system Python has no pytest, so they need the repo's own environment. I'll stop the waiter first so it doesn't bell me with those bogus results.The earlier runs used `~/.venvs/mfuton/bin/python` with `MFUTON_HOME` and `PYTHONPATH=src`. I'm relaunching both full suites that way, with a durable waiter.Both suite runs have exited, perhaps too quickly to be real, so I'm reading the logs before the waiter acts on them.I pushed the commits to mfuton-share, so Rob's `main` is now at `86cb927c` (was `16589072`). It was a straight fast-forward of 9 commits, with no host paths in the diff.

**Test suite:** I ran the full suite on both `main` and the branch before pushing. Both have 1,048 failed and 12 errors, which all come from this machine's setup. That's the 10 errors noted before plus 2 test files that can't load because the `datamodel_code_generator` package isn't installed. The branch passes 5 more tests than `main`; those are the new tests.

I removed the temporary worktree I used for the `main` run and added a note of the push to the journal. I pushed by explicit URL, so the local guard that blocks accidental pushes is still in place.
